interface.shortDescription: Save tasks and plan your day
interface.longDescription:
Sunlet is a calm daily planner for your tasks, lists and week. Connect it to ChatGPT to turn a conversation into tasks you will actually follow through on.

Ask ChatGPT to:
• Save the next steps from a conversation as Sunlet tasks, with dates, times and estimates
• Show today's plan, including overdue work, unscheduled tasks and tasks that have no time estimate yet
• Find tasks by topic, day, list or tag
• Move tasks to another day, change their details or mark them done. A repeating task gets its next occurrence
• Undo any change it made

Every change says exactly what was saved and can be undone. ChatGPT cannot delete tasks or create, rename or archive lists in Sunlet, and Sunlet does not invent free time: it has no access to your calendar.

Your tasks stay in sync with Sunlet on iPhone, the web and desktop. You need a free Sunlet account to connect, and you can disconnect at any time in Sunlet under Settings → Connected apps.

Privacy Policy: https://sunlet.app/privacy
Terms of Service: https://sunlet.app/terms
Support: hello@sunlet.app
